summary: Gone DNR live-in lookout on Mount Octopus: built about 1957, abandoned 1974, destroyed in the 1980s; sources disagree on county; no source describes the remains.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in the 1980s per FFLOS; Firelookout.com lists it as gone; no source describes what remains

staffing.status: Manned through the 1960s; final staffed year 1974, then abandoned (Willhite)

access.note: Reached through a DNR gate about 3/4 mile below the summit; Willhite says the gate was locked in the 1960s; current gate status not found

visit.trail_note: About 3/4 mile on foot from the gate without snow, up to 3 miles with snow (Willhite); check with DNR before going

corrections.why: FFLOS gives 'Removed 1980s' and says it was destroyed sometime in the 1980s; Willhite says it stood vacant into the 1980s. No source gives 1980.
Firelookout.com and the Washington Lookouts page both place it in Jefferson County, and the 1954 report quoted there says western Jefferson County. FFLOS says King County; see resolved_conflicts.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS lists King County; Firelookout.com and Washington Lookouts list Jefferson County. The story uses Jefferson and says the register differs.
FFLOS says destroyed sometime in the 1980s; Willhite gives only the 1980s and presents a prison-crew story as a tale. The story gives the decade only.
One Willhite account puts the locked gate 3 miles down the road; his directions put it 3/4 mile below the summit. The story uses the directions and says current gate status is unknown.

notes_for_editor: Record longitude -124.17775 conflicts with FFLOS coordinates W 121 10.699 (-121.178316). The record value fits 'about 16 miles southeast of Forks', so FFLOS may have a typo; check coordinates before publishing. County is split 1 King to 3 Jefferson; confirm the proposed correction. The prison-crew destruction story is Willhite's unverified tale. No WebSearch used; no source describes remains or current gate status. The destruction is dated only to the 1980s, so no destroyed event with a year is recorded; status_note carries the decade. Staffing evidence uses Willhite's oral-history accounts; names of individual former lookouts are left out.
